_comment: Federation Constellation spec: the stage tour, the code components of each app and the edges between them, read by src/hub/constellation.py and served by GET /api/constellation. Content (records, counts, samples, correlations) is never written here; the API reads it from the Hub store. Sibling-repo components cite the Hub doc or data file that names them (cites.mentions must appear in cites.doc); Hub components must exist on disk unless marked generated. Every cross-app handoff must be a declared edge in governance/federation_dependencies.yaml. tests/test_constellation.py enforces all of this.

code.label: CALL
code.meaning: Invokes or reads something inside the same app.

code.label: HANDOFF
code.meaning: An artifact crosses an app boundary as a file or package. Runtime RPC between producers is forbidden by governance/federation_dependencies.yaml.

content.label: RECORDS
content.meaning: Canonical rows moving between a producer stream and the Hub; the width follows the real total.

content.label: CORRELATION
content.meaning: Cross-producer links the Hub derived. Every one is a synthetic candidate, not an identity claim.

content.label: PROJECTION
content.meaning: Rows projected into the collections that TheHub's pages read.

stages.summary: Centinelas polls news feeds, labels each item by domain, and drops finance and political items as files for MoneySweep.
MoneySweep reads the Centinelas drops it cares about, places each one on a Puerto Rico municipality, and emits pre-official located finance candidates.
MoneySweep bundles located finance as GeoJSON. An operator copies the bundle to Spiderweb, which scores every feature and assigns evidence tiers T1 to T4.

stages.subtitle_es: Productores de dominio · OVNIS, AguaYLuz, Skywatcher
stages.summary: Three producers feed the Hub directly: OVNIS (case corpus), AguaYLuz (water and grid) and Skywatcher (airspace).
Each producer writes a canonical package (sources, entities, relationships and more, plus a sha256 manifest). Packages are the only way content reaches the Hub.
The Hub clones each registered producer, validates its package against the schemas, unions the rows, dedups them by deterministic id and stamps _producers provenance on each.
Six strategies link rows from disjoint producers: shared name, shared external id, spatial proximity, temporal proximity, alert footprints and observation footprints. Every link is a candidate.
Ingest loads the aggregate into data/hub.db and projects the collections that TheHub's pages and APIs read.
Seven apps, one direction of travel: producers hand artifacts to the Hub, and the Hub correlates and serves them.

components.name: centinelas run
components.summary: Runs ingest, classify, route and dispatch in order; each stage also has its own command.

components.name: sources.yaml
components.summary: The RSS/Atom feed list (global-topical wires today; PR-specific sources are future intake).

components.name: poll_all
components.summary: Polls the feeds and dedupes by item_id = sha256(url|published_at)[:16], yielding RawItems.

components.name: classifier
components.summary: Labels each item with one or more of six domains and returns a ClassifiedItem.

components.name: keyword rules
components.summary: Keyword fast path; a Claude Haiku fallback covers what the rules miss.

components.name: LABEL_TO_REPO
components.summary: Maps domains to destination repos: FINANCIAL and POLITICAL to moneysweep-pr, GEO_GEOLOGY to spiderweb-pr, and so on.

components.name: route
components.summary: Builds one payload per destination; only the MoneySweep payload carries the finance and location enrichment block.

components.name: dispatch
components.summary: Writes each payload to <repo>/intake/<item_id>.json and records a DispatchRecord. The file drop is the transport; there is no network hop.

components.name: run_all --ingest-centinelas
components.summary: Runs the Centinelas ingest and the contract-finance bundle build as one standalone lane.

components.name: ingest_centinelas_signals
components.summary: Turns kept drops into pre-official located finance candidates shaped like funding_award rows.

components.name: centinelas_intake
components.summary: Reads intake/*.json and keeps only FINANCIAL or POLITICAL drops (is_finance_relevant).

components.name: attribute_geo
components.summary: Resolves each drop to a PR municipality, falling back to municipality aliases in the title and body.

components.name: centinelas_intake exports
components.summary: funding_awards.jsonl and transactions.jsonl of pre-official candidates (award_id CS-CENT-<item_id>).

components.name: build_contract_finance_bundle
components.summary: Emits the four-file contract-finance handoff (export contract v1.2.0).

components.name: run_contract_finance_geo_reasoning
components.summary: Places each contract-finance row on a municipality.

components.name: contract_finance_bundle
components.summary: contract_awards.geojson, financial_flows.geojson, municipality_funding_density.csv and contract_finance_ingest_report.json.

components.name: build_contract_finance_layer
components.summary: Scores every feature (0.25 amount, 0.30 entity convergence, 0.25 municipal density, 0.20 temporal pulse) and assigns tiers T1 to T4; T3 and T4 go to manual review.

components.name: scored overlay
components.summary: The scored, tiered features plus contract_finance_layer_report.json with the Centinelas pre-official counts.

components.name: geocode_pr
components.summary: Census, Nominatim and Google geocoding behind a content-addressed cache and a PR bounding-box gate.
